name: Golgi vesicle traffic and secretory-lysosomal cargo sorting
rationale: All members concern vesicle traffic through and from the Golgi (intra-Golgi, COPI, TGN, Golgi-to-ER); unlike the confusables, which emphasise endosome-to-Golgi retrieval and COPI budding, this theme adds protein secretion and lysosomal targeting and vesicle biogenesis.

name: Deadenylation- and decapping-driven mRNA decay
rationale: Members cover poly(A) tail shortening, decapping, 5'-to-3' exonucleolytic decay, P-body assembly and poly(A)-linked stabilisation; confusables instead centre on ARE-binding protein stability control, zygotic decay or polyadenylation.

name: Extracellular sequestration of signalling ligands
rationale: All four members describe holding ligands such as BMP in the extracellular space to regulate signalling, whereas the confusables are the downstream TGF-beta/BMP, osteogenic and patterning programmes themselves.

name: HIF hypoxia response, glycolysis and erythroid oxygen transport
rationale: Members combine HIF-alpha oxygen sensing and hypoxic gene regulation with glucose catabolism, plus erythrocyte differentiation and oxygen transport, which distinguish it from confusables limited to glycolysis regulation (mTORC1/p53, fructose-2,6-bisphosphate) or gluconeogenesis.

name: Atypical-linkage polyubiquitin chain assembly
rationale: All members are K6-, K27-, K29-linked or free ubiquitin chain synthesis, unlike confusables about mitophagy or deubiquitinases.

name: Cullin neddylation and PD-L1 protein turnover
rationale: Members span neddylation/COP9 deneddylation, cullin-adaptor (RHOBTB, SPOP, BTRC) mediated degradation and protein stabilisation, with PD-L1 glycosylation and degradation and anti-tumour T cell regulation distinguishing it from confusables on other CRL substrates, PD-L1 transcription or general proteolysis.

name: Cardiac chamber myocardium, endocardium and septum morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern trabecular and compact myocardium, endocardium, atrial and ventricular septa and cardiomyocyte proliferation, distinguishing it from confusables on valves and cushions, coronary vessels or early heart tube and second heart field.

name: Classical complement activation and its negative regulation
rationale: All members are classical/antibody-mediated complement activation or its inhibition, whereas confusables add lectin, alternative, C3/C5 activation and opsonisation.

name: Non-Sanfilippo mucopolysaccharidoses and lysosomal glycosaminoglycan degradation
rationale: Members are lysosomal CS/DS, HS, keratan sulfate and hyaluronan degradation and the MPS I, II, IV, VI, VII, IX disorders; every confusable is defined by the heparan-specific MPS III Sanfilippo types this theme lacks.

name: Promotion of synaptic plasticity, LTP/LTD and spine growth
rationale: Members positively regulate long-term potentiation and depression, synapse maturation, spine morphogenesis, local translation and short-term memory, distinguishing it from confusables on cAMP/CREB, NMDA/AMPA receptor signalling or reelin-driven dendrite maintenance.

name: Pyrimidine nucleotide and deoxyribonucleotide biosynthesis and salvage
rationale: Members are de novo and salvage synthesis of UMP/UDP/UTP/CMP and dNTP (dTTP, purine dNTP) formation, unlike confusables on purine synthesis, nucleotide interconversion or pyrimidine catabolism.

name: Plasma contact activation, fibrinolysis and matrix proteolysis control
rationale: Members are FXII/kallikrein contact activation, plasminogen activation and fibrinolysis, MMP-driven collagen and elastin breakdown and their serpin inhibition, distinguishing it from confusables on the extrinsic/common coagulation cascade and VWF or on ECM adhesion.

name: Branched-chain amino acid catabolism, biotin carboxylases and organic acidemias
rationale: Members cover leucine, valine and isoleucine breakdown via BCKDH and its MSUD defects, biotin-dependent carboxylase deficiencies and related organic acidurias, unlike confusables on PDH/OGDH, lipoylation and lysine catabolism.

core: Membrane potential control by potassium channels
qualifier: two-pore, ATP-sensitive and Ca2+-activated K+ channels with Na+/K+ pumps
name: Potassium channels and Na+/K+ gradients setting membrane potential
rationale: Members are K2P, KATP and KCa channels, P-type ATPases and Na+/K+ homeostasis governing resting potential and action potentials, distinguishing it from confusables on renal sodium transport, negative regulation of excitability or hair cell and smooth muscle physiology.

name: Forebrain neuron migration and cortical lamination
rationale: Members are interneuron and radial migration, cortical layering and regionalisation, and development of thalamus, dentate gyrus and pyramidal neurons, unlike confusables on commissures, forebrain patterning or spinal cord.

name: Membrane transport of cationic amino acids and di/tricarboxylates
rationale: Members are arginine, lysine and ornithine transport and their disorders plus succinate/citrate and malate-aspartate shuttle carriers, distinguishing it from confusables on urea-cycle and glutamate metabolism, carnitine or pyruvate transport.

name: Craniofacial, palate and limb morphogenesis
rationale: Members are morphogenesis of the face, skull, palate, nose, limbs and digits with mesenchymal cell development, unlike confusables on neural plate, pharyngeal organ or ear development.

name: Treg promotion and suppression of effector T-cell responses
rationale: Members promote Treg differentiation and restrain CD4/CD8 activation, Th17 commitment and IFN-gamma, distinguishing it from confusables on tolerance and anergy, Th1 differentiation or DC-driven T cell activation.

qualifier: eNOS regulation and vascular smooth muscle relaxation
name: eNOS-NO-cGMP signalling and vascular smooth muscle relaxation
rationale: Members cover eNOS activation and trafficking, NO-cGMP signalling and vascular smooth muscle relaxation, unlike confusables on systemic blood pressure, renal guanylyl cyclase effects or shear-stress mechanosensing.

name: Neurotrophin-induced p38/ERK5-CREB transcriptional signalling
rationale: All four members are the nuclear arm of NGF signalling via p38, ERK5 and CREB phosphorylation, whereas confusables are receptor-proximal NTRK2/NTRK3/TRKA activation and Ras/PI3K/PLCG branches.

name: HIF-mediated oxygen sensing and hypoxic transcriptional response
rationale: Members are HIF-alpha prolyl hydroxylation, HIF-1alpha target regulation, BACH1 and hypoxia/glycolysis gene programmes, lacking the glycolytic enzyme, erythroid and NFE2L2 members of its confusables.

core: Renal sodium handling in blood pressure control
name: Aldosterone-responsive renal sodium handling and blood pressure
rationale: Members concern aldosterone response, sodium transport regulation, glomerular filtration and renal blood volume and pressure control, distinguishing it from confusables on vasopressin water balance, aldosterone synthesis or angiotensin signalling.

qualifier: Ca2+-activated scrambling, blebbing and cell volume
name: Plasma membrane phospholipid scrambling, blebbing and volume control
rationale: Members are aminophospholipid translocation and ANO6 Ca2+-activated scrambling with membrane blebbing and cell volume reduction, unlike confusables on ER lipid transfer or apoptotic cell clearance.

name: MHC class I antigen processing and cross-presentation
rationale: Members cover proteasomal antigen generation, ER transport, class I peptide loading, endosomal and phagosomal cross-presentation and CD8 T cell homeostasis, distinguishing it from MHC class II, Nef-mediated downregulation and proteasome assembly confusables.

name: Monocyte surface receptors and CD1 lipid antigen presentation
rationale: Members are monocyte surface and receptor signatures, monocyte differentiation and CD1/DC receptors for lipid and protein antigen presentation, unlike confusables centred on dendritic cell signatures, activated monocytes or TLR7 clusters.
